openspec.rationale: Exact pin per the repo dependency-pin discipline; version matches package.json. DEFAULT engine: detection order is pinned > openspec > speckit > native-kbd.
openspec.adapter: os* in lib/kbd/spec-backend.mjs (CLI-backed, spawned with no shell)

speckit.rationale: Exact pin per the repo dependency-pin discipline; adapter is markdown-based (no specify CLI is ever invoked) and the version is pinned for layout conformance with specs/<slug>/{spec.md,plan.md,tasks.md}.
speckit.adapter: sk* in lib/kbd/spec-backend.mjs (pure filesystem markdown parsing)
speckit.notes: artifacts under .specify/ and specs/<slug>/{spec.md,plan.md,tasks.md}; tasks.md is a markdown checklist "- [ ] T001 description"

native-kbd.rationale: Repo-owned backend; version tracks this repo, no external pin.

customEngines.hint: To plug in another spec engine, add an adapter object to the specEngines registry in lib/kbd/spec-backend.mjs implementing the five ops (list/progress/markDone/verify/archive) under the uniform (root, change, ctx) shape, add its detection shape to detectBackend and its id to the project.json specBackend pin values, then register its metadata here.
